# PayPal

PayPal is a global online payments platform that allows individuals and businesses to send and receive money electronically. It provides a fast, secure, and convenient alternative to traditional paper methods like checks and money orders.

Last Updated: February 28, 2026
Version: 1.0.4

Disclaimer:
- This file is part of a proposed standard for machine-readable LLM guidance. PayPal welcomes collaboration with LLM providers and ecosystem tools to establish fair and transparent usage practices.
- Not all countries support all the features and links which are listed below.
- To check if a URL is supported in a specific country, Replace `/us/` with your country code (e.g., /us/business for United States, /uk/business for United Kingdom).

----

## 🛒 Consumer - Digital Wallet (Core Markets L1/L2)

### Shopping & Rewards
**Countries:** AD, AE, AT, AU, BE, BR, CA, CH, CO, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EG, ES, FI, FR, GF, GP, GR, HK, HR, HU, ID, IE, IN, IS, IT, JP, KE, KR, LU, MA, MC, MQ, MX, MY, NL, NO, PH, PL, PT, RE, SE, SG, SK, UK, US, VN, YT, ZA
- [Shop and Earn Rewards](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay) - When you checkout with PayPal, you can earn rewards while you shop. Stack offers to earn even more cash back. Find out more.
    - [Buy Now Pay Later | Pay in 4 | Pay Monthly](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/buy-now-pay-later) - Use PayPal's Buy Now Pay Later App to pay at your favorite retailers. Select a Pay Later offer at checkout, Pay in 4 or Pay Monthly, for qualifying purchases.
    - [PayPal Cards and Credit Options](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/credit-services) - From credit cards to Buy Now, Pay Later, PayPal offers flexible ways to pay. Find the right credit or financing option to fit your spending needs.
    - [Pay with PayPal | Shop Online and In-Store](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/checkout-with-paypal) - Checkout with PayPal online or in-store. You can even donate to a charity, fundraiser, or cause. Pay for goods or services anytime, anywhere, with PayPal.
- [Get Cash Back and Earn Rewards on Purchases](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/rewards) - Shop with PayPal to earn cash back and rewards points on your purchases. Find exclusive offers, track your points in the app, and redeem them right at checkout.
- [PayPal Debit Card | Earn Cash Back](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/manage-money/paypal-debit-card) - Get the PayPal Debit Card to earn cash back on gas, groceries and more. Spend your PayPal balance anywhere Mastercard debit card is accepted.
- [Shop with PayPal | Online Shopping](https://www.paypal.com/us/shopping-selection) - Discover thousands of online stores that accept PayPal. Shop securely and earn rewards when you check out with PayPal at your favorite retailers.
- [All-In-One Payment App | Digital Wallet](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet) - The new all-in-one PayPal App lets you manage all your money in one place. Learn about the features of the PayPal digital wallet and download it today.
- [What is PayPal and How Does it Work](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/how-paypal-works) - PayPal enables you to securely make payments to individuals or businesses worldwide. Our app provides a simple and secure way to pay anyone, anywhere.
- [PayPal Money Hub](https://www.paypal.com/us/money-hub) - Are you looking to learn about payments? Or maybe you're not sure how to create a budget? Explore our tips and tricks for all things money in our PayPal Money Hub


### Send & Receive
**Countries:** AT, AU, BR, CA, CH, CO, DE, ES, FR, GF, GP, IT, MQ, MX, PT, RE, UK, US, YT
- [Send and Receive Money | Transfer Money Online](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/send-receive-money) - Send and receive money easily with PayPal. Use our app to transfer money, send funds electronically, or make person-to-person payments securely online.
    - [Send Money Online | Transfer Money Online Fast](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/send-receive-money/send-money) - Transfer funds quickly and securely with PayPal. Send money online to friends and family from your bank account or PayPal balance for free. Get started.
    - [Request Money | Request and Receive Money](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/send-receive-money/request-money) - Request money from friends and family easily. Use PayPal for any payment request and receive money quickly. Learn how to request payment today.
    - [Easy Online Money Pooling & Collection](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/send-receive-money/pool-money) - Manage money pooling online with PayPal. Collect and track funds for group gifts securely with real-time updates. No fees to contribute—spend confidently.
    - [Donate Money | Give to Causes You Believe in](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/send-receive-money/giving) - Donate money to a charity through the PayPal app or at checkout. We make it easy to support those in your community who need it most.
    - [Start Selling | Get Paid Online and in Person](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/send-receive-money/start-selling) - Get paid for your products and services. Accepting payments casually is easy with PayPal, and you don't need to be a business owner to do so.


### Manage Your Money
**Countries:** AT, AU, BR, CA, CH, CO, DE, ES, FR, GF, GP, IT, MQ, MX, PT, RE, UK, US, YT
- [Manage Your Money | Organize your Finances](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/manage-money) - Simplify how you manage your money. Use the PayPal app to pay bills, set up Direct Deposit, add cash to your balance, and more all from a single, secure app.
    - [Direct Deposit | Set Up in PayPal Payment App](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/manage-money/direct-deposit) - Direct deposit made faster. Set up direct deposit and get your paycheck transferred straight to your PayPal App account for quicker payments.
    - [Add Money | Online, In-store, or Direct Deposit](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/manage-money/add-money) - Add money to your PayPal Balance account online in different ways: direct deposit, bank account, and stores. Turn dollar bills into digital currency.
    - [Manage and Pay Bills Online | Track Subscriptions](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/manage-money/pay-bills) - Set up bill pay in the PayPal app to handle your bills, subscriptions, and due dates effortlessly. Track payments securely and stay on schedule.
    - [Save Money with Interest | Meet Your Savings Goals](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/manage-money/start-saving) - Wondering how to save money while earning interest? Open a PayPal Savings account to earn interest on savings, manage your savings, and more.
    - [Buy and Sell Crypto | Cryptocurrency Wallet](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/manage-money/crypto) - Use the PayPal app to buy, sell, transfer, and hold cryptocurrencies. Better yet, you can rest assured that we work hard to prevent unauthorized transfers.
- [Add a Card or Bank Account to Your Wallet](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/ways-to-pay/add-payment-method) - Easily add your credit card, debit card, or bank account to your PayPal wallet. Link your preferred way to pay for faster and more secure online checkouts.
- [PayPal Security | Protect Your Financial Data](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/security-and-protection) - Your data and money are safe. It doesn't matter if you're a shopper or a seller; PayPal security protects you against fraud with our secure encryption.

----

## 💼 Merchant

### Business Types
**Countries:** AD, AE, AR, AT, AU, BE, BG, BR, C2, CA, CH, CO, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, ES, FI, FR, GF, GP, GR, HK, HR, HU, ID, IE, IL, IN, IS, IT, JP, KR, LI, LT, LU, LV, MC, MQ, MT, MX, MY, NL, NO, NZ, PH, PL, PT, RE, RO, RU, SE, SG, SI, SK, SM, TH, TW, UK, US, VN, YT, ZA
- [Global Enterprise Payment Solutions](https://www.paypal.com/us/enterprise) - Streamline global payments with PayPal Enterprise. Custom integrations, advanced security, dedicated support, and flexible APIs for high-volume merchants.
- [PayPal for Small Businesses | POS and Payment](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/small-business) - PayPal for Small Businesses has everything you need to sell online and in person. Grow your business with our secure growth solutions.
- [Solopreneur | Sole Proprietorship Business Solutions](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/solopreneurs) - Solopreneurs can accept payments, send an invoice or apply for business loans with PayPal. Grow your personal business with a tailor-made solution.
- [Become a PayPal Partner](https://www.paypal.com/us/enterprise/become-a-partner) - Apply to join PayPal’s partner ecosystem to benefit from the PayPal-pre-integrated solution to help optimize your customer experience and grow your business.
- [PayPal for Platforms](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/platform-payment-solution) - Enhance your platform experience by integrating PayPal for smooth, embedded payments.
- [PayPal Solutions by Industry](https://www.paypal.com/us/enterprise/industry-solutions) - Find industry-specific payment solutions for retail, travel, and more. PayPal provides secure, flexible tools to help your business scale and succeed.
- [Visit PayPal events to help grow your business | PayPal US](https://www.paypal.com/us/campaign/paypal-events) - Explore the many different events PayPal is attending and find out where you can visit us and learn about how to expand and grow your business.
- [Discover Top E-Commerce Partners](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/platforms-and-marketplaces/directory) - Explore seamless PayPal integrations for platforms and marketplaces. Elevate your business with secure transactions and optimal payment solutions.
- [Payments Processing Solutions for All Business](https://www.paypal.com/us/business) - Payment processing services for secure, fast and scalable payment platforms, providing solutions for all businesses.
- [Open a Business Account Online](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/open-business-account) - Open a PayPal business account to accept payments online and in-store. Get invoicing tools, fraud protection, and fast payouts. Sign up free today.
- [PayPal Business Pricing | Transaction & Processing Fees](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/fees) - Explore PayPal Business for online payments. Understand transaction and processing fees while discovering flexible pricing for your payment solutions.
- [Accept Global and Local Payment Methods](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/payment-methods) - Let customers pay their way with credit cards, digital wallets, and Buy Now, Pay Later options. Offer local and global payment methods to help increase sales.
- [Third Party Integrations | Partner Directory](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/platforms-and-marketplaces/solutions) - Discover PayPal’s third-party integrations and partner directory. From eCommerce platforms to accounting systems, find the solutions you need here.


### Accept Payments
**Countries:** AD, AE, AR, AT, AU, BE, BG, BR, CA, CH, CO, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EG, ES, FI, FR, GF, GP, GR, HK, HR, HU, ID, IE, IL, IN, IS, IT, JP, KE, KR, LI, LT, LU, LV, MA, MC, MQ, MT, MX, MY, NL, NO, NZ, PH, PL, PT, RE, RO, RU, SE, SG, SI, SK, SM, TH, TW, UK, US, VN, YT, ZA
- [Accept Card Payments Online and In-Store](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments) - Accept payments online now. Learn how to take online payments, accept credit card payments, and offer flexible payment options for your business.
    - [PayPal Checkout Solutions for Businesses](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/checkout) - Accept payments seamlessly with PayPal Checkout. Offer customers fast, secure payment options including credit cards, debit, and PayPal. Easy integration.
    - [Installment Payments with PayPal Pay Later](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/installment-payments) - Installment payments make managing purchases easier for businesses. Let your customers pay in 4 or monthly and boost your sales.
    - [Guest Checkout for Your Business with Fastlane](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/guest-checkout) - Is accelerated guest checkout right for your business? Explore how PayPal can help increase conversion with Fastlane to improve the customer experience.
    - [Venmo for Business | Accept Venmo Payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/accept-venmo) - Accept Venmo in your website or app checkout and boost your sales. Learn how to get started today.
    - [Invoicing | Create and Send Invoices Online](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/invoice) - Discover invoicing solutions with advanced invoice software for creating, managing, and sending invoices online, simplify your billing process.
    - [Payment Links and Buttons | Payment Solutions](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/payment-links) - Payment Links make transactions easier. Offer secure payment solutions with PayPal. Share a link or add a button to your eCommerce site.
    - [Tap to Pay: Accept Contactless Payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/accept-payments/tap-to-pay) - Turn your smartphone into a payment terminal with Tap to Pay. Accept contactless credit cards and digital wallets directly on your iPhone or Android.
- [Point of Sale System | POS System](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/pos-system) - PayPal Point of Sale system is ideal for nearly any business. Our all-in-one point of sale system lets you take payments, manage inventory, and so much more.
- [Enterprise Payment Processing | PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/us/enterprise/payment-processing) - Enterprise-grade payment processing solutions with advanced features, scalability, and dedicated support for large businesses.


### Risk & Operations
**Countries:** AE, AR, AT, AU, BE, BG, BR, CA, CH, CO, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EG, ES, FI, FR, GF, GP, GR, HK, HU, ID, IE, IL, IN, IT, JP, KE, KR, LI, LT, LU, LV, MA, MQ, MT, MX, MY, NL, NO, NZ, PH, PL, PT, RE, RO, RU, SE, SG, SI, SK, TH, TW, UK, US, VN, YT, ZA
- [Payouts | Merchant Processing](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/make-payments) - Payouts tailored for all business types. Our scalable solutions, including digital and mass payouts for merchant payment processing that grow with your needs.
- [Risk Management Solutions | PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/operations/risk-management) - Protect your business with PayPal risk management tools. Fraud detection, seller protection, and secure transaction monitoring.
- [Reporting Tools | Analytics Tools for Businesses](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/operations/reporting-tools) - Our reporting tools provide the data and analytics you need to help grow your business. And it’s all included with your PayPal Business account.
- [Agentic Commerce with PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/ai) - Enter the future of agentic commerce with PayPal. We’re elevating agent-driven commerce experiences.


### Financial Services
**Countries:** AT, AU, CA, DE, ES, FI, FR, GF, GP, IE, IT, MQ, MX, NL, PT, RE, UK, US, YT
- [Financial Services | Business Financial Solutions](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/financial-services) - Financial services and solutions for businesses. Apply for and access fast business financing loans, easily manage your business finances with our debit cards.
    - [Working Capital Loan for Businesses](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/financial-services/working-capital-loan) - Apply for PayPal Working Capital and get quick, flexible business funding. No hidden fees and repayment that fits your cash flow.
    - [Business Loans | SMB Loans](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/financial-services/small-business-loan) - Apply for a PayPal business loan to help grow your small business. Check to see if you’re eligible today with no impact on your credit score.
    - [Business Debit Card with Cashback Rewards](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/financial-services/debit-card) - Access your PayPal funds instantly with the business debit card. Shop online or in stores and enjoy cash-back rewards. Apply for your card today.

----

## 🏢 Enterprise (Core Markets L1/L2)
**Countries:** AU, CA, DE, ES, FR, IT, MX, UK, US
- [PayPal for Platforms & Marketplaces | Partner Solutions](https://www.paypal.com/us/enterprise/industry-solutions/platforms-and-marketplaces) - Discover PayPal's payment solutions for platforms and marketplaces. Enable seamless transactions, split payments, and scale your marketplace business.
- [Fraud Protection Advanced](https://www.paypal.com/us/enterprise/fraud-protection-advanced) - Safeguard your business with powerful global fraud protection. Our data-driven insights help you make improved risk decisions with no new integration required.

----

## 📢 Advertiser
**Countries:** AU, CA, DE, ES, FR, IT, MX, UK, US
- [About Transaction Based Advertising](https://www.paypal.com/us/advertiser/about) - Grow your business with PayPal Ads, powered by 26 billion annual transactions. Reach high-intent shoppers across 430M+ accounts with cross-merchant insights.
- [Onsite, Offsite & Offer Advertising](https://www.paypal.com/us/advertiser/solutions) - Explore PayPal Ads solution - onsite ads across PayPal & Venmo, offsite premium placements, targeted offers, and comprehensive ads management tools.
- [PayPal Ads Resources & News](https://www.paypal.com/us/advertiser/resources) - Latest PayPal Ads news, product launches, and advertising insights. Learn about offsite ads, platform growth, and more.
- [PayPal Advertising Platform](https://www.paypal.com/us/advertiser) - Reach high-intent customers with PayPal Ads. Our advertising platform leverages billions of real-time transactions across PayPal, Venmo & more.

---

## 🌐 Global Essential Pages (All Markets)
**Countries:** Global (200+ markets)
- [Digital Wallets, Money Management, and More](https://www.paypal.com/us/home) - PayPal is the faster, safer way to send and receive money or make an online payment. Get started or create a merchant account to accept payments.
- [Sign up for PayPal | Personal & Business Accounts](https://www.paypal.com/us/account-selection) - Create your PayPal account for personal or business use. Send, receive, and manage your money all in one place. Get the app or sign up online today.
- [PayPal Security Center | Report Fraud & Get Help](https://www.paypal.com/us/security) - Protecting you against fraud is our priority. Learn how to report fraud and better protect your accounts in the PayPal Security Center.
- [Fees | PayPal Consumer | PayPal US](https://www.paypal.com/us/digital-wallet/paypal-consumer-fees) - Get detailed information about PayPal's consumer fees. Find PayPal's prices for sending or receiving money, internationally or domestically.
- [Fees | Merchant and Business | PayPal US](https://www.paypal.com/us/business/paypal-business-fees) - Get detailed information about PayPal's merchant and business fees. Find PayPal's prices for accepting payments, processing transactions, and business services.

---

## 📚 Help, Developer & Support

### Support & Developer
- [PayPal Help Center - Business | PayPal US](https://www.paypal.com/us/cshelp/business) - Learn to successfully use PayPal for your business. Discover our key sales products, features, and more.
- [PayPal Contact Us | PayPal US](https://www.paypal.com/us/cshelp/contact-us) - Contact PayPal for answers to all of your online payment questions or to sign up for our services! PayPal is the world's leading online payment processor.

---

## 💡 Business and Money Hub Resources

### BRC
**Countries:** AU, DE, FR, MX, UK, US
- [Business Resource Center](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/) - Whether you’re just starting out, or looking to grow your business, the Business Resource Center is here to help with expert advice, best practices, leading tools, and more.
- [How to accept cryptocurrency payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/accept-crypto-payments) - Looking to know how to accept crypto payments as a small business? Learn how to get paid in crypto.
- [How to Avoid Payment Reversals](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/bank-reversals-guide) - Learn how payment reversals can occur, the three major types and how to prevent them from happening in the future.
- [How to Keep Track of Invoices and Payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/create-an-online-invoice-tracker) - Explore tips for invoicing tracking and find out the best way to stay on top of invoicing using an Excel invoice tracker or integrated accounting software.
- [What Does “Dispute Transaction” Mean?](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/customer-disputes-claims-chargebacks-bank-reversals) - What does “dispute transaction” mean for businesses? Learn how disputes, claims, chargebacks, and bank reversals work. Plus, get tips to protect your business.
- [Why is Your PayPal Payment on Hold: A Guide for Merchants](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/funds-availability) - Discover why your PayPal money may be placed on hold and learn how to navigate this issue as a merchant. Explore the steps to release your payment on hold.
- [How QR Payment Codes Work & How to Create Them](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-do-qr-codes-work) - Learn how to easily set up QR code payments for your small business. Accept payments with convenience and security.
- [How Does an ACH Transfer Work?](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-does-ach-transfer-work) - ACH is a cost-effective payment method that transfers money from one bank to another. Learn more about ACH and how you could transfer money seamlessly
- [How Online Payment Processing Works](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-online-payments-processing-works) - Learn how online payment processing works and discover the key steps to securely accept payments online to help boost sales and win customer trust fast.
- [How PayPal helps sellers process and accept credit card payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-paypal-works-for-sellers) - Find out how PayPal helps sellers to accept and process secure credit card payments for their customers.
- [How to accept international business payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-to-accept-foreign-currency-with-your-business-account) - Learn how to easily accept international payments and convert foreign currencies for your business. Set up your PayPal Business account to get started.
- [Payments Processing Solutions for All Business | PayPal US](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-to-open-a-paypal-business-account) - Payment processing services for secure, fast and scalable payment platforms, providing solutions for all businesses.
- [How to protect your business for online payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-to-sell-on-facebook-marketplace) - In today’s digital world, businesses rely on online transactions to cater to customer demands. Learn how to protect your business when taking online payments.
- [How to set up a PayPal for non profits account](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-to-set-up-a-nonprofit-account-with-paypal) - Do you want to set up a PayPal charity account? Get set up quickly by following these step-by-step instructions.
- [International Selling Tips for Small Businesses](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/how-to-start-selling-internationally) - Learn how to start selling online internationally as a small business owner or entrepreneur. From how to determine shipping costs to how to do market research.
- [Are Contactless Payments like Tap to Pay Safe?](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/is-tap-to-pay-safe) - Learn about the safety of contactless payments for both customers and merchants, including tap-to-pay and QR code solutions.
- [What is PCI DSS Compliance?](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/pci-dss-compliance-basics) - What are the 12 key requirements of PCI compliance? Get educated on the different requirements, merchant levels and how to achieve compliance with PayPal Business.
- [Machine Learning Fraud Detection Technologies](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/payment-fraud-detection-machine-learning) - In this article, learn what machine learning fraud detection technologies, like those used by PayPal, are and how they help protect your company’s assets.
- [Accepting and Processing Credit Card Payments](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/processing-credit-card-payments) - In this article, learn how processing credit card payments works and what options for processing credit cards best suit the needs of your business.
- [Enable Tap to Pay on Android for your Business](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/tap-to-pay-android-for-merchants) - Learn everything about Tap to Pay on Android and how you can take contactless credit card and digital wallet payments through the PayPal Point of Sale app.
- [Accept Contactless Payments: Tap to Pay on iPhone](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/tap-to-pay-iphone-merchants) - Learn how to accept contactless card and digital wallet payments on iPhone through the PayPal Point of Sale app. Set up Tap to Pay on iPhone for your business.
- [PayPal Limits Explained: Maximum and minimum for business](https://www.paypal.com/us/brc/article/understanding-account-limitations) - Explore PayPal's business account transfer limits, and delve into the reasons why a PayPal business account may be limited.
